# Treatment-v8 — ForgeCraft-Generated Harness (lean CNT)

**Condition**: The harness is generated by forgecraft-mcp `setup_project` — NOT hand-tuned.
Tests whether ForgeCraft's current generator (post harness-diet, lean CNT) matches the
hand-built GS cascade arms (T2/T5/T7).

- **ForgeCraft commit**: 7a4b18e4105ff3e229e830dd30c2def7e05b0568 (v1.8 pre-release, lean templates)
- **Scaffold inputs**: REALWORLD_API_SPEC.md as spec_text; tags UNIVERSAL+API; typescript;
  mvp=false, scope_complete=true, has_consumers=true; 3 factual one-line aiFields (problem,
  users, success criteria). No hand-written use cases, no hand-tuned artifacts.
- **Prompts**: word-for-word copies of treatment-v7/prompts/ (00-infrastructure..06-integration).
  Note: prompts reference "CLAUDE.md § Commit Hooks" etc. — in the ForgeCraft CNT those live in
  .claude/standards/ branches. Whether the agent navigates the CNT to find them is PART of the test.
- **Known deviations from Phase 1 artifact checklist**: no pre-defined prisma/schema.prisma,
  no hand-written ADRs 001-004 (ForgeCraft generates ADR-000 + stubs; the agent writes ADRs
  per prompt 00). These are inherent to the condition: "what ForgeCraft actually gives you."
- **DB**: postgresql://conduit:conduit@localhost:5453/conduit_v8 (port 3008 for the server)
- **Run method**: `claude -p --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format json` per prompt,
  fresh process each, in output/project/. Tokens/cost/duration captured per prompt in evidence/.
- **Harness budget at scaffold**: see evidence/harness-budget.json

## Findings log (live)
- **F1 (setup)**: `pre-commit-secrets.sh` self-matches its own pattern definitions — the
  scaffold baseline commit required `--no-verify`. ForgeCraft bug: the secrets scan must
  exclude `.claude/hooks/`. Filed for v1.8.1.
- **F2 (P0)**: Agent emitted 20/20 infrastructure files but did NOT commit, despite the
  harness commit protocol. Not coached (protocol §2.2). Watching whether feature passes commit.
- **F3 (P1)**: Agent finished auth implementation but ENDED BY ASKING how to commit (the
  harness branch-check hook blocks direct commits to master; in headless mode nobody answers).
  Clarification exchange issued per run-notes anomaly protocol: answered "B" (chore scaffold
  commit + feat(auth) commit). Harness-design finding: branch protection conflicts with
  autonomous single-branch flow.
- **F4 (verification)**: First Hurl run: 1/13. Root causes are exactly the failure modes the
  v7-derived community gates encode (nullable-field coercion `bio:"" vs null`, DELETE 204,
  error envelope shape) — and those gates WERE installed at scaffold into
  `.forgecraft/gates/registry/api-contracts/` but sat DORMANT (never promoted to active,
  never surfaced to the agent during implementation). ForgeCraft v1.8.1 action: registry
  gates relevant to the active tags must be surfaced in the session context (e.g., routed
  via the CNT or promoted as default-active for their tag) — installing without surfacing
  preserved the failure. v7 hit the same class (6/13 first run) and needed 2 fix passes.
- **F5 (T2 phase)**: docs/use-cases.md still contained the 3 generic scaffold stubs after all
  7 prompts — agents updated specs/data-model/status per the doc cascade but never replaced
  the UC stubs, and check_cascade's existence check accepted them (stub acceptance).
  ForgeCraft action: behavioral_contracts step must detect FILL/stub content, and the UC
  triple-derivation needs explicit wiring into the feature flow. UC-population pass issued
  (lab-side, GS-cycle step) before L2 harness generation.
- **F6 (T2 phase)**: generate_harness auto-spec emits hollow template probes
  (`POST http://{{host}}/api/endpoint`, undefined `host` variable) — non-executable
  out of the box even though the UCs now carry machine-checkable acceptance criteria.
  This is the very pattern ForgeCraft's own l2-hollow-probe gate flags. v1.8.1 action:
  derive real probe bodies from UC acceptance criteria; run_harness must support a
  host/base-url variable. Probe-implementation pass issued (designed flow: AI fills TODOs).
